title: WSB Signals — common logical types & enumerations
description: Shared $defs referenced by every entity schema. These define the LOGICAL type vocabulary and the closed enumerations from data-model.md §3-§4. Physical storage types (int8 vs int4, timestamptz vs epoch-bigint, JSONB vs child table, numeric vs decimal) are DELIBERATELY DEFERRED to implementation time — each logical type carries an x-logical-type tag and the JSON-level domain constraint only. A field that may be undefined uses anyOf[type, null]; null means 'could not be computed', never zero.

Symbol.description: Instrument identifier (uppercase ticker). Natural key of instrument.

Real.description: Signed real, unbounded (differences, derivatives, z-scores, returns).

UnitInterval.description: Real in [0,1] (sov, h_e, h_m, normalized components, iv_rank, entropy breadth).

Ratio.description: Multiplicative ratio >= 0; 1.0 = parity/normal (rvol, pcr, uoa, eng_per_mention).

Money.description: Decimal currency amount as a string for lossless interchange. MUST bind to a decimal/numeric physical type, NEVER binary float. USD unless a currency field says otherwise.

Instant.description: A point in time, UTC. Epoch-seconds integer OR ISO-8601 string; one binding chosen project-wide. Tagged event-time or observation-time per field.

Duration.description: Elapsed time; logical unit declared per field via x-unit (e.g. hours, seconds).

SeasonalBucket.description: Index of a recurring calendar slot within a bucket_scheme (e.g. hour-of-week 0..167).

MapSymbolCount.description: Keyed multiset, e.g. flair_counts {"DD":2,"YOLO":7}. Normalizable to a child relation in an RDBMS.

MapStringCount.description: Keyed multiset over arbitrary string keys, e.g. Discord reaction_counts {"rocket":12}.

StringList.description: Ordered/unordered set of strings, e.g. Discord author roles.

Direction.description: From options/position language, not ironic sentiment. null = unclassified.

Resolution.description: Rollup window length. Extensible. 1h is the v0.0.1 primary.

Confidence.description: Quality/confidence flag travelling with a value (e.g. rvol_conf, set by feed).

Source.description: Ingestion tap. arctic_shift is the sole live Reddit tap in v0.0.1. Extensible.

WinLoss.description: Per-item outcome label. NEVER aggregated to a per-ticker rate (survivorship).

SignalMode.description: Degradation mode of a derived field (signals-catalog.md §1). Used in x-mode annotations: core = works on minimal data; enriched = quality rises with more sources; gated = impossible without a specific source.

CoverageScope.description: Why a ticker is in the market/signal layer: wsb_hot=pulled because WSB-hot; screener_mover=market-wide screener mover with no WSB heat (STEALTH candidate, no empirical row); both.

BucketScheme.description: Baseline seasonality scheme, chosen per resolution for warmup speed (1h:hour_of_week, 15m:time_of_day, 1d:day_of_week).
